name: Maximum clique in DIMACS C2000.9
definition: For the fixed simple undirected graph C2000.9, find a largest vertex set whose every distinct pair is connected by an edge.
solution_format: An object with vertices: a list of distinct zero-based vertex indices.
constraints: Every vertex index is an integer in 0..1999.
No vertex appears more than once.
Every pair of selected vertices is adjacent in the pinned C2000.9 graph.
verification: Exact all-pairs adjacency checks against the byte-pinned DIMACS source graph. The checker accepts any clique and does not infer optimality from its size.

source_review.definition: 固定DIMACS C2000.9，2000顶点1799532边，最大化两两邻接顶点集大小。补图独立集和点覆盖不再额外计数。
source_review.primary_source: Sol亲自读取Grosso–Locatelli–Pullan2005两页论文，先79再完整80顶点编号；逐一抄取80个零基编号，从CMU COLOR04官方下载19602828字节原始图，SHA256 aa4b1d7df7f9c1afbf8c9f35fcf5bdfc6370fd27db5c9f3fd5409dfd0d164f16。独立图edge-set解码后全部3160对存在。
source_review.record_and_status: Sol亲自读取Krpan–Povh2607.11726v1（2026-07-13），明确该图精确团数未知，下界80、作者报告认证上界168。大规模core/theta计算未本地复现，不把168标作主代理独立数学证书。
source_review.human_reproduction: 2005传统局部搜索发现的80点完整见证重放，reference与human80；没有将现代AI辅助图搜索结果归为该旧人类构造。
source_review.independent_math: 正式checker用逐顶点邻接bitset测试；Sol对每份构造列出所有所需顶点对，再独立扫描原始压缩DIMACS边流收集匹配，验证1799532条边与所需集合完全覆盖，未调用任务graph/check解析器。
source_review.controls: 初始1、16次传统62、256次演化71、人类/参考80。五程序、重复顶点破坏、完整声明分数不变、严格回放、仅公开压缩图冷导出、错误/非有限数/超时均通过。任务及共享检查41项通过。
source_review.limits: 未证明80最优、未重跑原作者发现搜索或2026的192线程751GiB大规模上界计算。
